title: Below 1024 pixels wide the tiles stack in one column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. A screen narrower than 1024 pixels: a phone, a tablet held upright, or a desktop browser zoomed in so that the screen width divided by the zoom is under 1024 (e.g. a 1920-wide screen at 200% zoom gives 960).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard (on a phone, open the menu button at the top left and choose Dashboard).
  2. Scroll from the top to the bottom of the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The six tiles stand one under another in a single column, each the full width of the screen: Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization, Sales by Customer, At Risk Customers.
  • No tile sits beside another and nothing runs off the right edge.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12. Terminology: small screen. Split out of C88626.
